name: aigenchain
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Aigenchain instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Aigenchain tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Aigenchain through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Aigenchain Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Aigenchain only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
